missing.why_not_infer: The printed weighted-loss objective is not a specified actor mapping or parameter aggregation equation; softmax/clipping/renormalizing cannot be assumed.

methods.title: SmartFL: Simple majority rule based Byzantine-robust federated learning

methods.formula_number_status: No formula or algorithm numbering can be certified from held primary text. Existing reports refer to method section/Appendix C; these are retrieval targets, not independently read formulas.

missing.required: Exact pairwise score, how each removal pair is chosen, ties/order, stopping condition, f/majority assumptions.
missing.why_not_infer: Row-mean cosine top-n-f is a different operation from iterative pair deletion.

missing.required: Normalized full parameters versus updates/gradients, reference formula, zero-norm and cancellation behavior.
missing.why_not_infer: Normalization before versus after summation and full-model versus delta semantics change the direction.

missing.required: Second-phase population/recall rule, positive/zero cosine boundary, final weights and norm restoration, empty-set fallback.
missing.why_not_infer: Positive-cosine selection, cosine-weighted aggregation and equal averaging are different algorithms.

missing.required: Complete model/training hyperparameters and method defaults, including any Appendix C supplement; all server-data assumptions.
missing.why_not_infer: Adapting shared CelebA local Adam or choosing constants without documenting the original/adaptation changes would not be a faithful full-method claim.

methods.title: FedDNA: Behavioural based approach for byzantine defense in federated learning via model fingerprinting and adaptive thresholding
methods.held_primary_text: Saved publisher XML contains coredata only. Existing author announcement/preview routes are not full Sections3/4 or defaults.
methods.formula_number_status: No fingerprint/history/threshold equation number can be certified from held primary text.

missing.required: Probe source/data permissions, number, construction/preprocessing, fixed versus resampled schedule and server access.
missing.why_not_infer: A fixed probe is an old-report mechanism summary, not a source-complete sampling/data-access specification; root/valid/test reuse cannot be invented.

missing.required: Exact layers, activation extraction, across-probe/neuron reduction, normalization and similarity/distance formula.
missing.why_not_infer: Parameters, logits, penultimate activations and concatenated layer outputs are different features.

missing.required: Per-client state/init, history reference/decay/window, consistency score, update order, new/missing-client handling.
missing.why_not_infer: Comparing to the current median or the previous model cannot substitute for the unknown history rule.

missing.required: Score being thresholded, center/MAD/scaling constant/multiplier, strictness/ties/zero-MAD, retained weights, full-model versus delta and empty/all-anomalous fallback.
missing.why_not_infer: A conventional3-MAD threshold on parameter norms is not the unspecified behavioral detector.

missing.required: Complete model/probe/strategy defaults and algorithm/experiment appendices.
missing.why_not_infer: Cross-architecture activations and threshold defaults cannot be chosen from the acronym or abstract.

methods.minimal_author_input: The exact DOI full PDF/accepted manuscript with method, implementation details and appendices, or source-matched strategy/probe/model code and defaults. Old share-link ATP-3 error does not establish permanent unavailability.

minimal_recovery_sequence: Root obtains source-matched author material stated per method; no new search or server experiment is necessary to specify the request.
Read and pin the complete algorithms, equations, defaults and legal data-access rules; code availability alone is not the accept/reject criterion.

If the full mathematical specification is sufficient, implement an isolated method adapter with equation/line map and explicit caller message semantics; preserve the existing image protocol and label any separately authorized adaptation.

First check deterministic fixed-input mechanics against the paper pseudocode/author implementation, including algorithm-specific boundaries and state restore; only then propose the smallest real-image gate for root authorization. No training or gate is executed by this package.

interface_requirements_to_resolve_before.FedWA: Inputs: stable client IDs, global/local model information and explicitly permitted reward observations; outputs: source-defined weights/model update and persistent policy/optimizer/RNG state. This is an integration checklist, not an invented original signature.
interface_requirements_to_resolve_before.SmartFL: Inputs: source-confirmed full models or updates plus any required f/majority parameter; outputs: exact filtered/recall indices, pseudo-reference and aggregate; no assumed n-f top-k.
interface_requirements_to_resolve_before.FedDNA: Inputs: source-confirmed models, permitted probe tensors and persistent per-client history; outputs: fingerprints/consistency/threshold/accepted set/aggregate and history. No probe constructed here.
